# Freelance Proposal Maker: win the job before you write the contract

> Free freelance proposal generator: state the client's problem, list deliverables, set a dated timeline and offer up to three priced options with deposits and an expiry date. Print, save as PDF or copy. No account, nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
